title: A demo brief made from a frozen research read hashes like the live read, so it does not show research changed right after it is made
steps: S1: research a place, freeze its research the way a demo action does, send it through JSON (as jsonb stores it), and hash it with researchKey.
S2: hash the live read with currentResearchKey.
S3: Retry one source that answers the same as before and hash the live read again.
S4: pass a Date to evidenceData.
expect: S1/S2: the two hashes are equal.
S3: the hash is unchanged and no new snapshot is published.
S4: the ISO string comes back, not an empty object.
evidence: e2e dev 24/10/2026: every agent demo brief showed research changed as soon as it was made; rawSources[].updated_at hashed as {} live and as an ISO string once frozen
fence: researchKey reads no per-attempt timestamp and evidenceData keeps Dates as ISO strings

tests: a brief made from a frozen research read hashes like the live read it froze
a Retry whose source answers the same keeps the snapshot, the brief and the logo research
evidence keeps a Date as its ISO string, not an empty object
